Cost: Invented Tech Upgrade (Upgrade DV17; material cost: the most expensive component drug + 100eb)
Type: Street Drug

Combines one dose each of two Street Drugs into a single dose. The DV to resist each drug's Secondary Effect rises by 2; otherwise the two drugs' effects and durations work separately. In Foundry, dose both component drugs.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Gear, Drugs, & Frames > Consumables > Street Drugs).
